decisions.reason: The caption typography details do not change the existing PBU naming rules or their coverage.
Theme colors are a separate clause and Requirement; the caption typography change does not alter the required palette state.
The broad requirement to apply the specified style system consistently remains valid unchanged; the caption typography details belong to the atomic typography Requirement.
The green level-four bullet is an independent clause already represented under bullet formatting; caption typography does not modify bullet appearance.
Caption font, size, line height, and italics do not change the required legacy copy-paste stability behavior.
The caption typography decision does not affect manual line-break entry after pasted content.
Formatting table labels does not alter the requirement that pasted tables and columns remain within the page layout.
Caption typography is unrelated to Tab-driven list-level transitions and hierarchy behavior.
Table-label typography does not change the constraint preventing right-column overflow during paste.
Caption typography does not change numbered-list or multi-digit alignment requirements.
The supported Word for Windows environment and operational-reliability constraints remain unchanged.
The specified caption font and formatting do not change document, default, or style-name language settings.
